changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to single 'Paper Review Generation', simplified dataset name, removed redundant model variants, normalized model names, and improved output description
Normalized metric variants to base forms (BLEU-4→BLEU, ROUGE-L→ROUGE) and consolidated F1 variations

changes_made.explanation: Removed all metadata since paper does not use LLMs as judges - the LLMs are used for generation, not evaluation of generated outputs
Dataset uses human expert reviews as ground truth, but does not conduct human evaluation of the generated LLM reviews

overall_notes: Paper focuses on evaluating LLM-generated paper reviews using a focus-level framework. Key finding: LLMs show biased focus toward technical validity while overlooking novelty assessment. The extracted metadata was largely accurate but needed normalization and consolidation of redundant items.
